questions.q: The 18th Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Summit 2026 was hosted in which city?
questions.explain: India chaired Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) in 2026 and hosted the 18th Summit in New Delhi, which adopted the New Delhi Declaration.

questions.q: Which country chaired Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) in 2026?
questions.explain: India held the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) chairship in 2026, a year after Brazil chaired the grouping in 2025.

questions.q: Bharat Innovates Exposition 2026, held alongside the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Summit, took place at which venue?
questions.explain: Bharat Innovates was held on 11-12 September 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, showcasing 37 deep-tech innovators.

questions.q: Who presided over the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in September 2026?
options: Dennis Francis of Trinidad and Tobago
questions.explain: Dr Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh presided over United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) 81; the General Debate ran from 22 to 28 September 2026 in New York.

questions.q: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar addressed the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) General Debate on which date?
questions.explain: Jaishankar delivered India's national address at United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) 81 on 26 September 2026.

questions.q: India and which country jointly launched the 'Group of Friends on Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers' in New York in September 2026?
questions.explain: India and Liberia launched the Group of Friends on 25 September 2026 on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York.

questions.q: The United States (US)-China agreement of 25 September 2026 set up a communication channel for incidents related to which technology?
questions.explain: Washington and Beijing agreed to an Artificial Intelligence (AI) incident communication channel and a Super Intelligence Dialogue.

questions.q: India's real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in Q1 Financial Year (FY)27 (April-June 2026) was:
questions.explain: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) data released on 31 August 2026 put Q1 Financial Year (FY)27 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth at 7.8%, up from 6.9% a year earlier.

questions.q: India's national accounts now use which new base year, replacing 2011-12?
questions.explain: The new Gross Domestic Product (GDP) series uses base year 2022-23 to reflect current prices, consumption patterns and new industries.

questions.q: As of September 2026, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) repo rate stood at:
questions.explain: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%; Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) was 5.00% and Marginal Standing Facility (MSF)/Bank Rate 5.50%.

questions.q: The 7th Global Fintech Fest 2026 was held in which city?
questions.explain: Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026 was held from 8 to 11 September at the Jio World Centre, Mumbai, with the theme 'Potential to Impact'.

questions.q: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) was live in how many countries as highlighted at Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026?
questions.explain: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) operates in 11 countries and processed about 24,509 million transactions in August 2026 alone.

questions.q: Under Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) 5.0, guarantee coverage is provided by which institution?
options: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
questions.explain: The National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC) provides the guarantee; MSMEs get up to 100% cover and others up to 90%.

questions.q: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026 replaces which earlier law?
questions.explain: The 2026 Act replaces the colonial-era 1891 Act and covers physical, electronic and digital bank records from 1 October 2026.

questions.q: According to the August 2026 Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) bulletin, the overall unemployment rate for persons aged 15+ was:
questions.explain: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) August 2026: unemployment rate 5.0%, Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) 55.6% and Worker Population Ratio 52.8% for ages 15+.

questions.q: The National Single Window System (NSWS) for business approvals is implemented by which body?
options: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
questions.explain: National Single Window System (NSWS) is implemented by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT); its 'Know Your Approvals' module helps investors identify the approvals they need.

questions.q: Semicon 2.0, the second phase of India's semiconductor programme, carries an outlay of:
questions.explain: Semicon 2.0 has an outlay of Rs 1,27,500 crore and includes strengthening Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging (ATMP)/Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) capacity.

questions.q: The indigenous dilution refrigerator developed for the National Quantum Mission achieves a temperature of:
questions.explain: The refrigerator cools qubits to 20 mK using Helium-3 and Helium-4, supporting the National Quantum Mission.

questions.q: Which space startup signed an agreement with the Technology Development Board on 25 September 2026?
questions.explain: Chennai-based Agnikul Cosmos, maker of the 3D-printed Agnilet engine and the Agnibaan rocket, signed the Technology Development Board (TDB) agreement.

questions.q: Ocean Research Vessel (ORV) Sagar Manthan, launched at Kolkata on 9 September 2026, was built by:
questions.explain: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE), Kolkata, built the ocean research vessel Sagar Manthan.

questions.q: On 7 September 2026, the Defence Acquisition Council accorded Acceptance of Necessity to proposals worth about:
questions.explain: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Rajnath Singh, cleared Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for about Rs 1.10 lakh crore, with roughly 98% sourced from Indian industry.

questions.q: The Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) Recce Vehicles cleared by the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) are used to:
options: Detect, identify, monitor and mark CBRN-contaminated areas
questions.explain: Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear) Recce Vehicles detect and mark contaminated areas for the Army.

questions.q: For the Navy, the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) cleared the procurement of which radars in September 2026?
questions.explain: Arudhra Radars will replace existing Air Route Surveillance Radars at naval air stations; Marine Gas Turbines were also cleared.

questions.q: India's first Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)-diesel dual-fuel Diesel Electric Multiple Unit (DEMU) train was flagged off from which station on 27 September 2026?
questions.explain: Amit Shah flagged off the Integral Coach Factory (ICF)-built dual-fuel Diesel Electric Multiple Unit (DEMU) from Sabarmati; its inaugural run was Sabarmati-Mahesana, with Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) replacing about 40% of diesel.

questions.q: Paradip Port was designated a 'Mega Port' in September 2026 under which law?
questions.explain: Paradip (Odisha) was notified as a Mega Port on 25 September 2026 under Section 73 of the Indian Ports Act, 2025.

questions.q: The Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP) provides cover for which set of risks?
options: Hull, Cargo, Protection and Indemnity (P&I) and War risks
questions.explain: Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP) covers Hull, Cargo, Protection & Indemnity and War risks, reducing dependence on foreign insurers.

questions.q: The National Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccination Campaign provides a free single dose primarily to:
questions.explain: The campaign, launched in February 2026, targets 14-year-old girls to prevent cervical cancer; over 80 lakh doses were given by 11 September 2026.

questions.q: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) provides cashless hospitalisation cover of how much per family per year?
questions.explain: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) gives Rs 5 lakh per family per year; its September 2026 backgrounder marked the scheme's 8th anniversary.

questions.q: Rajasthan became the first state to achieve 100% saturation under which scheme in September 2026?
questions.explain: Rajasthan achieved full PM Vishwakarma saturation on 26 September 2026 with 22.4 lakh artisans across 18 trades.

questions.q: Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act (AFSPA) was extended in September 2026 for six months in specified areas of which states?
questions.explain: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) extended Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act (AFSPA) from 1 October 2026 in disturbed areas of Manipur, Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh.

questions.q: Who became the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Apple Inc. on 1 September 2026, succeeding Tim Cook?
questions.explain: John Ternus, earlier Senior Vice President (SVP) of Hardware Engineering, became Apple's Chief Executive Officer (CEO); Tim Cook moved to Executive Chairman.

questions.q: The 72nd National Film Awards (for 2024 films) were presented at which venue?
questions.explain: President Murmu presented the awards on 22 September 2026 at Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), the first time the ceremony was held outside Delhi.

questions.q: Which film won Best Feature Film at the 72nd National Film Awards?
questions.explain: Article 370 won Best Feature Film, and Yami Gautam won Best Actress for the same film.

questions.q: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 72nd National Film Awards went to:
questions.explain: Veteran Kannada actor Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024.

questions.q: Best Actor at the 72nd National Film Awards was shared by:
questions.explain: Mammootty (Bramayugam, his fourth Best Actor award, equalling Amitabh Bachchan) shared the honour with Kartik Aaryan (Chandu Champion).

questions.q: The 20th Asian Games 2026 were held at:
questions.explain: The Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games ran from 19 September to 4 October 2026 with 43 sports and 469 medal events.

questions.q: India's women's cricket team won the Asian Games 2026 gold by defeating which team in the final?
questions.explain: India beat Sri Lanka by 148 runs; Smriti Mandhana scored 79 off 45 balls in the final.

questions.q: At the 46th International Chess Federation (FIDE) Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, India won which medals?
options: Silver in Open, Gold in Women
Gold in Open, Bronze in Women
Silver in Open, Bronze in Women
questions.explain: India took Open silver (behind Uzbekistan) and women's bronze (behind China) and retained the Gaprindashvili Cup for the third straight time.

questions.q: Who won silver for India in the women's 49 kg weightlifting at the 2026 Asian Games?
questions.explain: Mirabai Chanu won silver in the women's 49 kg category at Aichi-Nagoya.

questions.q: World Ozone Day, observed on 16 September, commemorates the signing of which treaty?
questions.explain: World Ozone Day marks the Montreal Protocol, signed on 16 September 1987 to phase out ozone-depleting substances.
